[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 34::Three years.
]


On a bill of exchange or promissory note payable at a fixed time after sight or after demand.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the fixed time expires.
